items.title: Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs
items.feed_excerpt: The four-year agreement will cover rice farms across three Indian states, reaching about 100,000 hectares at peak delivery.

items.title: India’s Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
items.feed_excerpt: Pocket FM uses AI to produce 99% of its new content, helping make content production about 80 times cheaper.
